## Purpose

This page summarizes the standalone technical scope of M7 - Natural Language Processing.

## Technical Scope

- Python runtime with requirements-managed dependencies
- Execution through Python module entry points
- Supports raw text and text-file based input
- Environment-variable or .env-based endpoint configuration
- Focused on non mission-critical workloads

## Run Guidance

python -m source.ner_component --text "..." and python -m source.sa_component --text "..."

## Expected Outcome

A reproducible execution path suitable for technical validation, demonstrations, and staged integration into platform workflows.
